POGD.description: Pushover Global Control (POGD). Single global-setting record (only key 1 exists); its behavior is driven by the two required nested option objects NONL_OPT (nonlinear analysis control) and PHOP_OPT (pushover hinge option), plus the initial-load list INITLOAD.

GEOMNONLINEAR_TYPE.description: Geometric nonlinearity type. Case-insensitive enum. NONE = none, LARGE_DISP = large displacements, P_DELTA = P-Delta.

INITLOADMETHOD.description: Initial load analysis method. Case-insensitive enum. PERFORM_ANAL = perform nonlinear static analysis, IMPORT_RESULT = import static/construction-stage analysis result.

INITLOAD.description: Initial load case list. Each item names a load case, its type, and a scale factor applied as the pushover initial load.

LC_NAME.description: Load case name (resolved to an internal load-case key at write time).

LC_TYPE.description: Load case type. Case-insensitive enum; value is the wire string (e.g. ST=Static, CS=Construction Stage). ST=Static, RS=Response Spectrum, TH=Time History, MV=Moving, SM=Settlement, ENVL=Envelope, CB=Load Combination, CBS=Steel Comb., CBC=Concrete Comb., CBF=Footing Comb., CBR=SRC Comb., PO=Pushover, CS=Construction Stage, ES=Eccentric Spectrum, GI=Grid Model, THEX/THAM/THPO=Time History variants, CN=Crane, CBA=Aluminum Comb., CBSC=StlComp Comb., CBCF=CFSteel Comb., CBSM=Seismic Comb., CBTH=History Comb., CBLN=Linear Eval Comb., NRS=Spectrum(ND), NES=Eccentric Spectrum(ND).

SF.description: Scale factor applied to this initial load case.

bCONSIGNOREELEM.description: Consider ignored elements for the nonlinear-analysis initial load (relevant when INITLOADMETHOD = PERFORM_ANAL).

NONL_OPT.description: Nonlinear analysis option block. SUBSTEP and MAXITER are required; convergence-norm and analysis-stop flags are optional toggles.

bPERMITFAIL.description: Permit convergence failure during nonlinear analysis.

SUBSTEP.description: Nonlinear analysis maximum number of substeps.

DISPLNORM.description: Displacement norm tolerance (used when bDISPLNORM = true).

FORCENORM.description: Force norm tolerance (used when bFORCENORM = true).

ENERGYNORM.description: Energy norm tolerance (used when bENERGYNORM = true).

bSHEARYIELDSTOP.description: Analysis stop on shear component yield.

BSHEARYIELDSTOPBEAM.description: Analysis stop on shear component yield - Beam/Column (relevant when bSHEARYIELDSTOP = true).

bAXIALYIELDSTOP.description: Analysis stop on axial component collapse/buckling.

bAXIALYIELDSTOPBEAM.description: Analysis stop on axial component collapse/buckling - Beam/Column (relevant when bAXIALYIELDSTOP = true).

bAXIALYIELDSTOPTRUSS.description: Analysis stop on axial component collapse/buckling - Truss (relevant when bAXIALYIELDSTOP = true).

bSUPPORTDZDIRSTOP.description: Analysis stop on support uplifting/collapse in the Dz-direction.

bSUPPORTSTOPUPLIFTING.description: Analysis stop on support uplifting: Dz-direction (relevant when bSUPPORTDZDIRSTOP = true).

bSUPPORTSTOPCOLLAPSE.description: Analysis stop on support collapse: Dz-direction (relevant when bSUPPORTDZDIRSTOP = true).

PHOP_OPT.description: Pushover hinge option block. Trilinear/bilinear stiffness-reduction values, apply types, reference locations, and confidence factor are required; the ultimate-rotation scale factors are optional and only take effect under Eurocode concrete+steel design codes.

bASSIGNBYMEMBER.description: Assign hinge properties to member only for Moment-Rotation Beam/Column.

TRI_TENS_A1.description: Trilinear default stiffness reduction - Tension a1.

TRI_TENS_A2.description: Trilinear default stiffness reduction - Tension a2.

TRI_COMP_A1.description: Trilinear default stiffness reduction - Compression a1.

TRI_COMP_A2.description: Trilinear default stiffness reduction - Compression a2.

BI_TENS_A1.description: Bilinear default stiffness reduction - Tension a1.

BI_COMP_A1.description: Bilinear default stiffness reduction - Compression a1.

PSPR_APPLY_TYPE.description: Point spring support apply type. Case-insensitive enum. APPLY = apply nonlinearity, ASSUME = assume elastic.

ELNK_APPLY_TYPE.description: Elastic link apply type. Case-insensitive enum. APPLY = apply nonlinearity, ASSUME = assume elastic.

LOC_BEAM.description: Reference location of beam/distributed hinges. Case-insensitive enum. I = I-end, J = J-end, M = center/mid.

LOC_COLUMN.description: Reference location of column. Case-insensitive enum. I = I-end, J = J-end.

SF_WALL.description: [Eurocode design only] Scale factor for ultimate rotation - wall scale factor. Ignored unless both concrete and steel design codes are Eurocode.

bSF_BRITTLE.description: [Eurocode design only] Use brittle scale factor for ultimate rotation.

SF_BRITTLE.description: [Eurocode design only] Brittle scale factor for ultimate rotation.

bSF_EARTHQUAKE.description: [Eurocode design only] Use earthquake scale factor for ultimate rotation.

SF_EARTHQUAKE.description: [Eurocode design only] Earthquake scale factor for ultimate rotation.

bSF_SMOOTH_BAR.description: [Eurocode design only] Use smooth-bar scale factor for ultimate rotation.

SF_SMOOTH_BAR.description: [Eurocode design only] Smooth-bar scale factor for ultimate rotation.

SND_SEIS_GRUP.description: [Eurocode design only] Secondary seismic elements group name.

bBUCKLING.description: Calculate yield surface of beam considering buckling.

NODECONNECTIVITY.description: Wall node connectivity. Case-insensitive enum. PINNED = pinned, FIXED = fixed.

bSHOWGRAPHAFTER.description: Misc - show pushover curve result dialog after analysis finishes.

bSHOWGRAPGHDURING.description: Misc - show real-time pushover curve during analysis.
